translated_title: The Largest Investment in History Is Already Underway, Mexico's Infrastructure Ministry Says
original_title: SICT: La inversión más grande de la historia ya está en marcha
author: Jessika Becerra
meta_description: Roads, 3,000 km of new rail and 62 upgraded airports will generate nearly 4 million jobs, says Minister Esteva—722 billion pesos in added investment this year, 2% of GDP.
